title: The Swapped Jam Labels
story: For the blind tasting at the St. Brendan's spring supper, Hattie peeled the labels off all the jams, her own included. For once in her life, she did not make a list. The judges have their ribbons ready, and nobody can say whose jam is whose. Can you match each cook with a jam and a jar before the ribbons go out?

texts: The fig jam's maker did not use the mason jar.
Ruben used neither the mason jar nor the crock.
The plum jam's maker used the crock.
Hattie did not use the crock.

trace.text: Clue 3 says directly that the plum jam goes with the crock.
Ruben must go with the tin: clue 2 rules out the mason jar and the crock.
Hattie must go with the mason jar: clue 4 rules out the crock; the tin already goes with Ruben.
Lou must go with the crock: the other choices are already taken.
The fig jam must go with the tin: clue 1 rules out the mason jar; the crock already goes with the plum jam.
The quince jam must go with the mason jar: the other choices are already taken.
The plum jam must go with Lou: Hattie and Ruben are already ruled out for the crock.
Ruben goes with the tin, so Ruben also goes with the fig jam.
Hattie must go with the quince jam: the plum jam is already ruled out for the crock; the fig jam already goes with Ruben.
